blocking_classes.required_closure: Derive checkpoint selection, payload reads, reset/invalidation counts, evaluation ranges, and resume mode from an ordered primitive event stream.
Score the complete decoy inventory, independently select the longest valid checkpoint, and bind restored, synchronized, cold, and final token lineages.
Bind every case name to exact family, flag value including empty, eligibility, mutation, expected mode, reads, resets, and evaluation ranges.
Require self-describing coverage and content hashes for every correctness-relevant state member and reject missing or unprobed ranges.
Validate start memory, wrapper and lock identity, cgroup containment, terminal status, and absence of a bare-engine launch.

bounded_medium_corrections: Bound decompression and output token domains; reject non-finite derived deltas.
